The opinion states that abandonment is an exception to the warrant requirement and that abandonment turns on retained reasonable expectation of privacy, not formal property rights.

Abandonment is the dispositive Fourth Amendment doctrine in Section III of the opinion.
The court affirmed denial of suppression because Small abandoned the phone and therefore no longer retained a reasonable expectation of privacy in it.
